{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is negative or near-zero, especially after recent spikes.",
    "Reduce forecast overshoots following high volatility or sentiment spikes by applying a 10-15% dampening factor.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias: if forecast is > 10% above recent 7-day average, reduce by 5-10%.",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to sentiment when it is positive (e.g., >0.33) to capture upward momentum.",
    "Correct for lag: if true outcome is > 20% higher than 30-day moving average, adjust forecast upward by 5-8%.",
    "Avoid overreacting to early sentiment signals; delay correction until 2-3 days after sentiment shift.",
    "For downward trends, apply a floor correction at 5% below recent low if sentiment remains negative."
  ]
}
